note: IMG-04 curation of the 46 principle-only genesis entries. Applied by catalog.build(). Proposed templates are not in the pwm_core registry (read-only here); they are proposals for upstream.

decisions.reason: Differential interference contrast microscopy is an imaging modality; the registry already has dic, which the title matcher missed.
gaps: no honest template: the primitive registry has no shear/differential-phase primitive (the existing conv2d -> poisson_gaussian is a generic stub, not DIC)
decisions.template_fidelity: generic stub (conv2d blur); not a DIC forward model

decisions.reason: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry is imaging; registry dexa was linked to the wrong principle (L1-307).
decisions.template_fidelity: canonical chain in the validated registry (dual_energy_beer_lambert); not validated on hardware

decisions.reason: fNIRS is diffuse optical imaging; registry nirs_brain was linked to EELS (L1-251, carrier electron).
gaps: registry template is a generic stub with a 'Coded Mask' element, which fNIRS does not have
decisions.template_fidelity: nominal: gaussian-blur diffusion + Beer-Lambert; not a photon-diffusion solver

decisions.reason: Scanning TEM is imaging; registry stem was linked to plain TEM (L1-246).
gaps: registry template has no scan stage
decisions.template_fidelity: nominal: incoherent probe blur + raster subsample; no explicit source node (electron_beam_source returns a constant and discards the object); no coherent contrast, no aberrations

decisions.reason: 4D-STEM records a diffraction pattern per probe position; the nearest registry modality is electron_diffraction, which was linked to Fresnel diffraction (L1-401).
gaps: registry template is a single-pattern diffraction camera: no scan dimension, so not 4D-STEM; a separate 4D-STEM registry entry is needed upstream
decisions.template_fidelity: single-pattern |FFT|^2 only; the 4D (scan x pattern) structure is not modelled

decisions.reason: STEM-EDX is imaging (elemental maps); registry edx_mapping had no link.
gaps: no honest template: yield_model is a scalar and energy_resolving_detector ignores n_channels and energy range (returns x*qe), so there is no spectral axis

decisions.reason: LiDAR point-cloud imaging; registry lidar had no link.
decisions.template_fidelity: runs: scan -> time-of-flight gate -> SPAD; sensor is qe scaling only (dead time not modelled)

decisions.reason: Flash LiDAR with a SPAD array is imaging; registry flash_lidar had no link.
gaps: no honest template: spad_tof_sensor returns x*qe and ignores dead_time_ns, so no chain with this sensor models a SPAD array

decisions.reason: X-ray radiographic NDT is imaging; registry xray_ndt was linked to medical radiography (L1-196).
decisions.template_fidelity: nominal: monoenergetic Beer-Lambert transmission; no scatter, beam hardening or focal-spot blur

decisions.reason: PAUT is imaging; registry ultrasonic_phased_array had no link and its carrier was shown as xray.
gaps: no honest template: beamform_delay averages over axis 0 with no delays, and the principle's full-matrix capture has no primitive

decisions.reason: Phase retrieval is a computational imaging problem; registry phase_retrieval was linked to CDI (L1-234).
decisions.template_fidelity: runs: angular spectrum -> |.|^2 -> Poisson; nominal, not validated

decisions.reason: CT reconstruction is the principle behind registry ct (real_data); it was linked to Industrial CT (L1-272).
decisions.template_fidelity: unchanged (real_data level comes from the flagship paper, not from this link)

decisions.reason: Accelerated MRI reconstruction is the principle behind registry mri (real_data); it was linked to Sonar (L1-262).
decisions.template_fidelity: unchanged (real_data level comes from the flagship paper, not from this link)

decisions.reason: Acoustic-emission source localization maps to registry acoustic_emission (array localization, a passive imaging modality).
gaps: registry template is a generic stub

decisions.reason: X-ray phase-contrast imaging is imaging and has no registry entry (checked contrib/modalities.yaml: 170 ids, none is phase contrast).
gaps: no template: thin_object_phase is x*exp(-sigma|x|), an amplitude attenuation, not a phase shift, so a phase-contrast chain cannot be built honestly
needs a phase-object (projection-approximation) primitive and a propagation-based or grating detector

decisions.reason: THz time-domain spectroscopy is listed as imaging by the owner (THz-TDS imaging); registry terahertz is linked to THz imaging L1-277, which is a different principle, so a separate entry is proposed.
gaps: no template: no pulsed-source/delay-line primitive and no time axis; level stays 'registered'
borderline: single-point spectroscopy is not imaging unless raster-scanned; confirm with the owner
